issue.entity: Zenith Allied Metals S.A. de C.V.
issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (North America)

plan.diagnosis: Zenith Allied Metals S.A. de C.V. (Mexico) represents USD 1,366,108 in annual spend with a single-source sub-tier dependency among 45 sub-tier suppliers, despite a strong resiliency score of 87. One disruption event in the past 12 months demonstrates vulnerability, and the lack of alternate sourcing at the sub-tier level creates unmitigated supply chain risk for this Medium-severity exposure.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier mapping workshop with Zenith Allied Metals to identify the critical single-source sub-tier supplier(s) among the 45 and assess category criticality, lead times, and technical specifications
Issue RFI to minimum 3 alternate sub-tier suppliers in North America region to qualify technical capability, capacity, and willingness to serve as backup source
Negotiate dual-source agreement with Zenith Allied Metals requiring qualification of at least one alternate sub-tier supplier with 20% volume allocation to backup source
Execute supplier development program including on-site audit and sample order with qualified alternate sub-tier supplier
Formalize sub-tier resilience clause in master agreement requiring Zenith to maintain minimum two qualified sources for critical materials and notify buyer of any sub-tier changes within 30 days

plan.expected_impact: Mitigate single-source sub-tier risk on USD 1,366,108 annual spend and avoid potential disruption costs estimated at 15-25% of spend (USD 204,916 to USD 341,527) based on the one disruption event experienced in the trailing 12 months.
kpis: Number of qualified alternate sub-tier suppliers (target: minimum 1 within 90 days)
Percentage of volume allocated to backup sub-tier source (target: 20% within 6 months)
Sub-tier supply chain visibility score (baseline 45 mapped suppliers, target: 100% criticality assessment)
Disruption event frequency (baseline: 1 event per 12 months, target: 0 events)
risks: Alternate sub-tier suppliers may lack technical qualification or capacity for specialized metals specifications
Zenith Allied Metals may resist transparency or dual-sourcing due to existing sub-tier relationships or cost impact
Qualifying new sub-tier sources may require 12-16 week lead times for testing and validation, extending timeline
Volume split may increase piece-price by 5-8% due to loss of economies of scale at primary sub-tier
Contractual constraints at sub-tier level may limit Zenith's ability to onboard alternates quickly
erp_actions: Create supplier attribute in SAP LFA1 for 'Sub-Tier Risk Flag' and mark Zenith Allied Metals S.A. de C.V. with value 'SINGLE_SOURCE_SUBTIER' for reporting visibility
Add info record note in SAP (EINE) for all Zenith POs requiring sub-tier source disclosure on order acknowledgment
Configure approval workflow in Coupa requiring Procurement Director sign-off for POs exceeding USD 50,000 to Zenith until dual sub-tier sourcing is confirmed
Create alternate vendor source list entries in SAP (EINA/EINE) once backup sub-tier supplier is qualified, with 80/20 quota arrangement
Set up sub-tier supplier record in Oracle EBS supplier hierarchy linking qualified alternate to Zenith parent record for traceability
Enable automated alert in NetSuite when Zenith monthly spend exceeds USD 125,000 (10% over run-rate) to flag concentration risk until remediation complete
